general_information.Description: This course will introduce the student to the essential aspects of information security and incident response (IR). The student will be provided with the tools, techniques and industry accepted methodologies so that upon completion of the course the student will be able to describe key concepts of network security and incident response and how those concepts apply to themselves and their organization.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit in time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FPTU cms at http://cms.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
general_information.Tools: Internet, VMWare, Kali Linux, FTK, SleuthKit, EnCase, Wireshark, Netwitness Investigator

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Build and equip an IR team for success; enhance an infrastructure or organization to facilitate the IR process.
Collect initial facts, understand methodical investigation and network evidence.
Develop leads, identify indicators of compromise, and determine incident scope.
Analyze data from networks, enterprise services, and applications.
Investigate Windows and Mac OS X systems.
Create and implement comprehensive remediation plans
